slots.name: Iran opposition ratio
slots.sentence: As for the war in Iran, it was already the only U.S. war in the history of polling that more Americans opposed from the very start — and what support there was has cratered even further, with voters now against it 2 to 1.

slots.name: plan amount
slots.sentence: In Washington, the question is whether that control is beginning to slip amid Republican resistance on Capitol Hill to his plan to give $1.8 billion in taxpayer money to his supporters who claim to have been mistreated by the Biden administration and his nomination of Todd Blanche as attorney general.
